title: The Clock That Struck Thirteen
central_conflict: the clock tower rang thirteen times at noon
decisive_choice: a second hammer was rebounding from a loose spring
resolution: replaced the spring and counted twelve clear strikes
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the clock tower rang thirteen times at noon before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they reset the hands but the extra chime returned; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a second hammer was rebounding from a loose spring; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they replaced the spring and counted twelve clear strikes, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Unequal Market Scales
central_conflict: the market scales gave different weights for identical sacks
decisive_choice: one leg of the table rested on a loose floorboard
resolution: leveled the table and recalibrated the scales with standard weights
